insights.summary: Tonbo Imaging (NSE: TONBO) held its Q2 FY27 analyst meet on 6 Nov, but only the investor presentation and an audio recording are on Screener, so this run uses the presentation. H1 FY27 revenue was ₹219 Cr (+183% YoY on a weak H1 FY26), made of a ₹36 Cr Q1 and a ₹183 Cr Q2 (EBITDA 24.1% margin, PAT ₹23.5 Cr). The order book is ₹250 Cr with ₹408 Cr of contracts under negotiation. Management gives no numeric guidance, only a positive FY27 outlook and a warning that quarters will stay lumpy.

what_changed.text: Positive FY27 and medium-term outlook backed by ₹250 Cr order book and expected POs
Revenue volatility between quarters expected to continue; track annually
Platforms expected to grow alongside a directed-energy system over 3-4 years

tone.label: cautious
tone.quote: Quarter-on-quarter revenue volatility has been seen historically and will continue, given the nature of the defence business.

red_flags.text: Working capital is stretched: inventories ₹266 Cr and receivables ₹235 Cr against cash and bank balances of ₹9 Cr (plus ₹15 Cr in other bank balances); H1 operating cash flow was -₹48 Cr and short-term borrowings rose to ₹147 Cr from ₹116 Cr at March.
Gross margin fell to 34.6% in H1 from 52.5% a year earlier (FY26: 51%) as lower-margin platform work grew.
Order book fell to ₹250 Cr from ₹314 Cr at June and ₹279 Cr at March; tactical systems order book is only ₹44.5 Cr.
Q1 FY27 was an EBITDA loss (₹-13 Cr) and a PAT loss (₹-17.7 Cr); H1 PAT is just ₹5.8 Cr, a 2.6% margin.

watch_next: Q3 FY27 revenue and whether the order book converts: ₹250 Cr in hand plus ₹408 Cr under negotiation

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Thermal and night-vision sights, EO/IR imaging, gimbals and fire-control systems, with directed-energy (RF, laser) systems in development; fabless, built by partners
business_snapshot.customers: Armed forces, DRDO, PSUs, OEMs and integrators, and international militaries in 24+ countries
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: H1 FY27: tactical ₹123 Cr (56%), platform ₹94 Cr (43%); export share 36% (6% in FY26 against 66% in FY25). FY26: tactical 58%, platform 40%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Indian and EU soldier-modernisation programmes, counter-drone and fire-control demand, export orders
